lastCompletedStory.title: Add durable dispatch-failed marker with status projection and resolved stop semantics

nextStoryContext: The durable dispatch-failed marker primitive and cam status projection now exist. performStop intentionally preserves the marker; later stories own removal only after a successful dispatch or terminal convergence. Use DISPATCH_FAILED_FILENAME at every TypeScript call site. The embed generator emits this filename with an equivalent Unicode escape so templates/.gitignore still round-trips byte-for-byte without duplicating the bare literal under src/.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Only Node.js standard-library filesystem and path APIs plus existing internal status and stop helpers were used; no external library was touched.
